# Task #66 deterministic Human Wizard level 1 Abjuration-school fixture.
# Mirrors the accepted SD13-E4-R3 Human Wizard level-1 fixture
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_wizard_level1_sd13_deterministic_input.txt)
# ability/feat posture exactly, swapping only the school specialization
# choice from Evocation to Abjuration (Necromancy/Transmutation stay as the
# two opposed schools -- they remain legal opposition choices regardless of
# which school is specialized in, since PF1's only opposition restriction is
# "not your own specialty school and not Divination").
#
# It deliberately avoids every other spell-support surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no arcane bond resolution,
# and no opposed-school bookkeeping. It adds only the minimum choice data
# needed to make the Abjuration school-power grounding (Resistance,
# Protective Ward, Energy Absorption) legible at level 1.
case_id=task66-pf1-crb-human-wizard-level1-abjuration
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:1
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:abjuration
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
